'''Aurean vultures''' were a large [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Vulture/Legends|vulture]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aurea]]. Possessing wings of over 4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, they lived in the planet's [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] where they stayed adrift on warm updrafts until, using their brilliant [[Eye/Legends|eye]] sight, they spotted prey. The vultures will then pursue their target as a [[flock]], for [[Standard day/Legends|days]] at a [[Time/Legends|time]] if necessary, after which, at the height of [[Standard day/Legends|day]], they swoop down at the angle of the [[Star/Legends|sun]] to attack. They use the sun in the hope that their prey, which could include sentients, would be blinded and unable to fight back effectively. Aurean vultures would use their beaks and talons to attack.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aurean vultures were mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system.
